correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary sequence of (K,i) with K→∞ and λ_K=K a_i→λ∈(0,∞), i→∞ and i=o(sqrt K). Root indicators are bounded 2-dependent; mean K/3, variance 2K/45 and connected-cumulant argument yield normal S_K. Each rare-gap indicator uses an (i+4)-length priority window, so deleting i+6 root sites and a (2i+7)-site rare-event neighborhood gives an independent Y_j, (S_j,D_j) triple. The Poisson Stein equation and subtraction produce exactly 2λ(i+6)/sqrt(2K/45)Lip(h) + λε_i||h||∞. With published neighboring u_i~(i/4)a_i², v_i~a_i², ε_i→0, proving mixed-test factorization and independent joint weak convergence. Independent 6!/7! enumeration confirmed exact mean, variance and gap expectations; infinite inference is analytical and depends on correct overlap probabilities.
